question: Manyakheta or Malkhed was the capital of which of the following kingdoms?
solution:
The correct answer is__** ​Rashtrakuta.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Manyakheta, located in** present-day Karnataka**, served as Rashtrakuta's imperial capital, from where they controlled a large and prosperous empire.
 
• The Rashtrakutas ruled a significant portion of the Indian subcontinent between the **8th and 10th centuries. **
 
• The Rashtrakutas were known for their contributions to art, architecture, and culture, particularly the rock-cut temples at **Ellora.**
 
• One of the most prominent rulers of the Rashtrakuta Dynasty was** Amoghavarsha I **(ruled c. 814–878 CE).
